source_text: A flask was loaded with diacetoxypalladium (6.39 mg, 0.03 mmol), BUTYLDI-1-ADAMANTYLPHOSPHINE (0.020 g, 0.06 mmol), sodium 2-methylpropan-2-olate (0.164 g, 1.71 mmol) and methyl 2-amino-2-methylpropanoate (0.2 g, 1.71 mmol). The flask was evacuated and backfilled and toluene (5ml) and 1-chloro-4-methylbenzene (0.168 ml, 1.42 mmol) was added.The mixture was stirred for 20h at 120°. No conversion of startingmaterial was observed.
